statBlock.name: Lunar Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: An alabaster dragon newly hatched from a stony egg. Lunar dragons carve their lairs into barren moons.

sections.Traits:
Tunneler. The wyrmling digs through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. across.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d8) cold damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a success, halve the damage and leave its speed unchanged.
sections.Bonus actions: Phase (2/day). The wyrmling becomes partly incorporeal while it maintains concentration as if on a spell. It resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage in this state. Its phase does not let it pass through creatures or solid objects.
sections.Lunar dragon ages: Young Lunar Dragon, Adult Lunar Dragon, and Ancient Lunar Dragon are the older forms.

statBlock.name: Megapede
statBlock.description: A fur-armored centipede that can reach 150 ft. It ambushes prey under loose sand or in deep caverns and carries its eggs on its back.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Bite once and use either Life Drain or Psychic Bomb.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and 22 (5d8) poison damage.
Life Drain. Each other creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save against the megapede's magic. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Psychic Bomb. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and avoids incapacitation.

statBlock.name: Mercane
statBlock.description: A tall blue merchant in fine robes who trades in magic items and information on the Astral Sea. Mercanes share warnings about customers who cheat one of their own.

sections.Languages: Common, Giant, telepathy 60 ft. (see also Mercane telepathy).
sections.Traits: Mercane Telepathy. The mercane can speak telepathically with any mercane it knows, at any distance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Psi-Imbued Blade attacks.
Psi-Imbued Blade. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage on a hit. A creature hit must also pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or be frightened of the mercane until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, the mercane casts a spell from the list below. It uses Intelligence (spell save DC 15) and needs no components.
At will. Detect Magic, Light.
1/day each. Dimension Door, Invisibility, Mage Armor (self only).

statBlock.name: Murder Comet
statBlock.description: A screaming stone head in a trail of fire. Its creator fuses the essences of an Earth Elemental and a Fire Elemental. It prowls Wildspace for ships and crews.

sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Explode. At 0 hit points, the comet bursts in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature inside takes 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, or half as much on a successful one.
Flyby. Leaving an enemy's reach while flying provokes no opportunity attack.
Illumination. The comet gives off bright light within 30 ft., then dim light for another 30 ft.
Siege Monster. Its attacks and effects deal double damage to objects and structures when they can damage them.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam attack and one Spit Fire attack.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Spit Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d10 + 2) fire damage.
sections.Creator-bound form: A creator can bind their spirit to the comet and take its form, becoming ageless and immortal. The comet bears the creator's face. Use the creator's Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, alignment, and languages in place of the base comet's.

statBlock.name: Neh-thalggu
statBlock.description: A six-legged brain collector from the Far Realm. Its head develops a bulge for each stored brain, and after collecting twelve it focuses on finding a way home.

sections.Languages: Deep Speech. See Brain Dump for additional languages.
sections.Encounter setup: Roll 1d12 to set the number of brains the collector already has. Track any more it consumes during the encounter.
sections.Traits:
Brain Dump. After it consumes a brain, the collector magically learns to speak and understand the languages the former owner knew.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage on a hit.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid. On a hit, deal 35 (10d6) piercing damage. If that reduces the target to 0 hit points, the collector kills it and consumes its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Choose one Humanoid the collector can see within 10 ft. It makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and avoids incapacitation.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast a spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 11) and no components. Each spell can be cast once per day if the collector has consumed at least its listed number of brains. Casting does not spend a brain.
1 brain. Arms of Hadar.
2 brains. Detect Magic.
3 brains. Magic Missile.
4 brains. Tenser's Floating Disk.
5 brains. Darkness.
6 brains. Hold Person.
7 brains. Invisibility.
8 brains. Spider Climb.
9 brains. Fear.
10 brains. Hypnotic Pattern.
11 brains. Major Image.
12 brains. Stinking Cloud.

statBlock.name: Neogi Hatchling Swarm
statBlock.classification: Medium swarm of Tiny aberrations, typically lawful evil
statBlock.description: A mass of newborn neogi that hunt together instead of fighting one another for food.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces or traverse ceilings without an ability check.
Swarm. The swarm can enter another creature's space, and other creatures can enter its space. The swarm fits through gaps large enough for one Tiny neogi hatchling. It can neither regain hit points nor gain temporary hit points.
sections.Actions: Swarm of Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Deal 22 (6d6 + 1) poison damage on a hit, or 11 (3d6 + 1) if the swarm is at half its maximum hit points or fewer. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
sections.Adult neogi: Neogi Pirate and Neogi Void Hunter are adult forms.

statBlock.name: Neogi Pirate
statBlock.description: An adult neogi crew member, often aboard a nightspider. It uses dyes and other markings to show its rank and identify its leader.

sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The pirate has advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces or traverse ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) poison damage. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage on a hit.
sections.Other neogi: A Neogi Void Hunter often captains a nightspider. A Neogi Hatchling Swarm is a cluster of newborn neogi.
